proposed.text: Per PD 1096 Rule XII, Sec. 1207(2)(b), what is the formula for computing total exit width?

options.text: Occupant Load multiplied by 165 = total exit width in meters
Occupant Load divided by 165 = total exit width in meters
Floor Area divided by 100 = total exit width in meters
Occupant Load divided by 50 = total exit width in meters

proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: The exit width formula is: Total Exit Width (m) = Occupant Load ÷ 165. The divisor 165 is a capacity factor representing persons per meter of clear exit width. When exit width is computed at a level through which occupants from adjacent storeys pass, stacking percentages are added: 50% from the first adjacent storey above and 25% from storeys beyond.
